description: Favorite retry: the new retry loop has no attempt cap and retries every error, so a permanent database error spins the request forever.
notes: FM-05 (unbounded loops and retries). retryWhileBusy loops until the write succeeds, with no attempt or time cap, and it retries every error, not just SQLITE_BUSY. A permanent error (a closed or read-only database, disk full, a constraint failure) makes the handler sleep-loop forever: the client hangs and goroutines pile up. Severity important: FM-05 grades important; there is no external API cost. Fix: retry only busy/locked errors, cap attempts (or total time) and return the last error; or set SQLite's busy_timeout. The test and the wiring are legitimate.
